notes: Pair with headless gary4local over your network: enter the address and pairing token from its listen on command in gary4local host.
Yuey checks a source's length before uploading, and says what to crop instead of rendering one too long to continue.
When yuey refuses a request, gary shows yuey's reason instead of an HTTP code.
Pair with gary4local v0.7.7. Close your DAW before replacing plugin files.
